Step 1: Fact given: Bob is kind.

Step 2: Rule “All kind things are young” plus fact “Bob is kind” licenses: Bob is young.

Step 3: Rule “All young things are cold” plus derived fact “Bob is young” licenses: Bob is cold.

Step 4: Rule “Cold things are green” plus derived fact “Bob is cold” licenses: Bob is green.

Rejected step: Rule “If something is kind and not smart then it is green” cannot be used for Bob, because the condition “Bob is not smart” is not satisfied; in fact, Bob is smart.

Rejected step: Rule “If Bob is not young and Bob is not cold then Bob is round” cannot be used, because Bob is young and Bob is cold, so its conditions are not satisfied.

ANSWER: True
